subject: Warmech encounter
text: Reset with the power option after saving outside Mirage Tower, then reach the bridge before 20 encounters so Warmech is the 20th encounter.

evidence.quote: You start outside of mirage tower, pop a tent down and save, now reset the game, but instead of a normal reset, use the power option. Reload your save and climb the tower, count how many encounters you got, you need to get up there before 20. If you get to the bridge before 20 encounters hit, the 20th encounter should be WarMech.
